name: Onfleet
summary: Last-mile delivery management platform with a documented Route Optimization API: a caller schedules an optimization over tasks and teams, starts the engine, polls status and applies the result. Its cost model is public and per-parameter: a cost per unit of distance, a one-time cost for dispatching a vehicle at all, and a penalty per unit of time an order is delivered past its window. This version claims `scm.optimize-delivery-routes` on those parameters, under the outcome merged in #70. The optimization endpoints are Enterprise-plan only.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-14, no credentials: GET onfleet.com/api/v2/organization 401 InvalidCredentials, no www-authenticate; the API key is the Basic-auth username. mcp.onfleet.com/mcp answers 401 with resource_metadata, full OAuth discovery and a registration endpoint, and is in no vendor doc.

jobs.summary: Claimed on the vendor's published cost model, not a marketing sentence: `costPerUnitDistance` is the "fuel/mileage-based cost proxy", `fixedCost` is charged "for dispatching a vehicle at all", and `costPerUnitLateTime` prices delivery "past its time window". Windows are priced, not constrained.
